mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dt.device_code,d.dept_id from sys_dept d LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t dt ON d.DEPT_ID = dt.dept_id WHERE dt.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} and dt.industry_code=#{industryCode} and dt.device_type NOT IN(8,9)

SELECT DISTINCT ot.province_id AS provinceId, ot.city_id AS cityId, ot.county_id AS countyId, od.dept_id AS deptId FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t od LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t ot ON ot.device_code = od.device_code WHERE od.industry_code = #{industryCode} and od.tenant_id =#{tenantId} and ot.category_code = '1' and od.device_type = '10'

SELECT DISTINCT s.custom_name as device_name, s.id as device_code FROM sys_layer s LEFT JOIN vm_organ_layer_rel_t od ON od.layer_id = s.id AND s.TENANT_ID = od.TENANT_ID AND s.industry_code = od.industry_code WHERE s.delete_flag = '0' and od.delete_flag = '0' AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
and s.industry_code=#{industryCode}
